title: MmuPV1 L1- Cytokeratin Dual Immunofluorescence with Tyramide Signal Amplification
author: Aayushi Uberoi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.i8cchsw
materials: Deparaffinize section in 3 changes of Xylene for 2 minutes each in coplin jars. Rehydrate deparaffinized sections in an ethanol gradient series as follows: Twice in 100% ethanol, then once in 95%, 70%, 50%, 25%, 12.5% and final rehydration in double distilled water. Wash sections twice in 1X PBS. Block endogenous biotin by incubating sections in 0.3% Hydrogen peroxide in Methanol for 10 mins. Wash sections twice in 1X PBS. Before performing antigen retrieval, prepare a boiling water bath by placing a slide chamber filled with antigen retrieval buffer (pH=9) (abcam ab93684) in a tupperware container filled with water, and pre-heat for 7 minutes 30 seconds at highest power level in the microwave specification. Place slides from Step v into the pre-heated slide chamber. Microwave the slide chamber/tupperware container for 1 minute at high power to bring slides to boiling temperature. Microwave for an additional 19 minutes at 30% power level. Cool slides to room temperature by placing the entire slide chamber on the lab bench for at least 1.5 hours. Wash slides twice in 1X PBS and then circle tissue with hydrophobic pen. Wash tissue in 1X PBST (2l PBS+1gm Tween-20) 3 times for 3 minutes each

steps.title: Prepare Biotin-Tyramide Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Synthesize a 1 mg/ml biotin-tyramide stock solution using the following procedure:

substeps.instruction: Prepare Stock solution A (active ester) by dissolving Biotin-NHS in N,N-Dimethylformamide (DMF) at 10mg/ml (prepare freshly).
Prepare Stock solution B (tyramine stock) by dissolving Tyramine hydrochloride in DMF at 10mg/ml; add 1.25-fold equivalent amount of triethylamine (10 µl of 7.2M) per ml.
Add 1.1 fold equivalent amount of Stock A to Stock solution B and leave at room temperature (RT) in the dark for 2 hours to generate biotin-tyramide.
Dilute biotin-tyramide conjugates with ethanol to obtain a final Biotin-tyramide stock solution of 1 mg/ml.

steps.title: Block Tissue and Apply First Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Block the tissue and incubate with the first primary antibody (anti-L1).

substeps.instruction: Apply TSA blocking buffer to tissue (e.g., 20µl for a single section) and incubate at room temperature for 1 hour in a humidifier chamber.
Rinse tissue in 1X PBST (2l PBS + 1gm Tween-20).
Apply primary antibody (e.g., rabbit-anti-L1 at 1:5000 dilution) and incubate overnight in a humidified chamber at 4°C.

steps.title: Apply HRP Secondary Antibody
steps.instruction: Apply the HRP-conjugated secondary antibody to the tissue.

substeps.instruction: Wash slides 3 times for 3 minutes each in 1X PBST.
Apply Goat-anti-rabbit-HRP secondary antibody (e.g., 1:500 dilution) in blocking buffer for 1 hour at room temperature in a humidified chamber.

steps.title: Prepare Tyramide Reaction Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the reaction buffer and activate the biotin-tyramide complex while the secondary antibody is incubating.

substeps.instruction: Prepare reaction buffer by adding 1µl 30% Hydrogen peroxide solution to 30ml 0.1M Imidazole solution.
Bring the 1mg/ml biotin-tyramide stock solution to room temperature.
10 minutes prior to the end of the secondary antibody incubation, dilute biotin-tyramide stock solution 1:100 with reaction buffer (e.g., 30µl biotin-tyramide added to 3ml reaction buffer).
Allow the mixture to sit for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Perform Tyramide Signal Amplification
steps.instruction: Apply the activated biotin-tyramide complex to the tissue.

substeps.instruction: Wash tissue in 1X PBST 3 times for 3 minutes each.
Incubate slides with the biotin-tyramide-complex for exactly 10 minutes at room temperature.
Wash tissue in 1X PBST 3 times for 3 minutes each.

steps.title: Apply Second Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Apply the second primary antibody (anti-K14) to the tissue.

substeps.instruction: Rinse tissue with 1X PBST (2l PBS + 1gm Tween-20).
Apply anti-K14 (Covance) primary antibody at 1:1000 dilution at room temperature for 1 hour.

steps.title: Final Detection and Mounting
steps.instruction: Apply secondary detection reagents, nuclear stain, and mount the slides.

substeps.instruction: Wash slides in 1X PBST 3 times for 3 minutes each.

Incubate tissues for 1 hour at room temperature with the following secondary detection reagents: 1:200 anti-rabbit conjugated with Alexafluor488 (for K14) and 1:200 anti-streptavidin conjugated with Alexafluor594 (for biotinylated L1).
Stain with Hoechst for 10 minutes.
Wash in PBS and coverslip with mounting media.
